findings.title: bridgeERC20 shows the Base token only by ticker; a wrong or fake remote token looks the same.
findings.evidence: descriptor bridgeERC20 field `_remoteToken` 'Token on Base' format tokenTicker chainId 8453; case 0 shows 'Token on Base: BORING' and no address. The L2 bridge mints or releases only for the correct token pair, so a wrong _remoteToken leaves the funds locked.
findings.fix: Show `_remoteToken` as addressName (types ["token"]) or add it next to the ticker, so the signer can check which token arrives.

couldNotCheck: 0x3154cf16…2c35 is an L1ChugSplashProxy that delegatecalls an implementation read from the EIP-1967 slot. The implementation (L1StandardBridge) is not in the directory, and meta.json wrongly says isProxy false. So I could not check the code of any bridge, deposit or finalize function, such as the burn path for OptimismMintableERC20 tokens or the onlyOtherBridge and msg.value checks.
